newsitem.title: USA: Ill. Superconductor boosts board by two.
newsitem.headline: Ill. Superconductor boosts board by two.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said on Tuesday it expanded its board to seven from five members with the election of Tom Powers and Michael Friduss.

Powers was formerly the president of the cellular systems business unit of AT&T Network Systems Group, now Lucent Technologies Inc. Friduss is president of MJ Fidruss & Associates), a telecommunications consultant company.
Illinois Superconductor manufactures and sells radio frequency products to enhance the capacity of cellular telephone and other wireless telecommunications services.
